description: Fetches specified fields for a specific label on a Trello board; this read-only action does not return information about which cards the label is attached to.

fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to include in the response for the label, or 'all' for all fields. Valid fields: 'color', 'idBoard', 'name', 'uses'.
fields.title: Fields

idBoard.description: The unique identifier of the Trello board.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idLabel.description: The unique identifier of the label within the specified board.
idLabel.title: Id Label

name: get_boards_labels_by_id_board_by_id_label

GetBoardsLabelsByIdBoardByIdLabelRespons.description: Contains the detailed information for the retrieved Trello label.

color.description: The color of the label. Null means no color and the label will not be shown on the front of Cards. Valid values: yellow, purple, blue, red, green, orange, black, sky, pink, lime, or null
color.title: Color

id.description: The identifier for the label (24-character hexadecimal string)
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: The ID of the board the label is on (24-character hexadecimal string)
idBoard.title: Id Board

name.description: The name displayed for the label (0-16384 characters, nullable)
name.title: Name

GetBoardsLabelsByIdBoardByIdLabelRespons.title: GetBoardsLabelsByIdBoardByIdLabelResponse
